subject: general
question: Who was appointed as Indian Envoy to Bangladesh in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **Vikram Kumar Doraiswami**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikram Kumar Doraiswami** was appointed as the Indian Envoy to Bangladesh in October 2020.
 
• He succeeded Riva Ganguly Das in this position.
 
• Before this appointment, Doraiswami served as the Additional Secretary in the Ministry of External Affairs.
 
• He has also served as the Ambassador of India to South Korea.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Indian Envoy**
 The official diplomatic representative of India to a foreign country, responsible for managing diplomatic relations.
 
 

 **Bangladesh**
 A neighboring country to India, sharing cultural, historical, and economic ties.
 
 

 **Ministry of External Affairs**
 The Indian government department responsible for managing India’s foreign relations.
 
 

 **Ambassador**
 A diplomatic official accredited to a foreign sovereign or government, or to an international organization, to serve as the official representative of their own country.
